title: Most of the time price comes back to the midnight open when Asia was wild

hero.caption: On a wild Asia night, a big overnight range, NQ comes back to the midnight open **64%** of the time. On a quiet night it's only **25%**. I took every day price pushed 75+ points off the level since 2016, and the size of the Asia range is what splits them. The return mostly lands around the NY open.

useIt: I check the Asia range before the open. Quiet night, I don't expect the midnight open to come back, so I don't fade toward it. Wild night, it usually gets retested around 9:30, so I keep it as a level on the chart. It's a read on the day, not an entry.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested over 2016–2026 · check it yourself
